+{
+  Four-way interleaved AES-NI ECB block transforms for TAes.DoBlocks.
+  The caller passes groups of four 16-byte blocks; remaining 0..3 blocks
+  are handled by the existing DoBlock path.
+  Only XMM0..XMM4 are used, so Win64 nonvolatile XMM6..XMM15 are intact.
+  No TAes field is written; the routine is reentrant/thread-safe.
+}
+
+procedure AesNiEncryptBlocks4(var p: TAesNiBlocks4Params);
+{$ifdef FPC}nostackframe; assembler; asm{$else}asm .noframe{$endif}
+        {$ifdef ABIWINX64}
+        mov     rax, rcx                     // Win64: p=rcx
+        {$else}
+        mov     rax, rdi                     // SysV: p=rdi
+        {$endif ABIWINX64}
+        mov     r8,  qword ptr [rax].TAesNiBlocks4Params.groups
+        mov     r10, qword ptr [rax].TAesNiBlocks4Params.src
+        mov     r11, qword ptr [rax].TAesNiBlocks4Params.dst
+        mov     rax, qword ptr [rax].TAesNiBlocks4Params.ctxt
+        test    r8, r8
+        jz      @done
+        {$ifdef FPC} align 16 {$endif}
+@by4:   // four independent AES-NI streams, 64 input bytes
+        movups  xmm0, dqword ptr [r10]
+        movups  xmm1, dqword ptr [r10 + $10]
+        movups  xmm2, dqword ptr [r10 + $20]
+        movups  xmm3, dqword ptr [r10 + $30]

 ### Added 
 - Preliminary compatibility with Delphi 13.1+ Linux MacOS Android iOS

-- new `mormot.core.fmt.pas` and `mormot.core.i18n.pas` units
+- new `mormot.core.fmt.pas` `mormot.crypt.factory.pas` `mormot.net.peercache.pas` `mormot.net.server.win.pas` `mormot.net.proxy.pas` extracted units
+- Text resources translation via the new `mormot.core.i18n.pas` unit
 - XML pull/SAX/DOM Parser
 - YAML 1.2 Read and Write Support
 - HTTP Proxy Cache
 - HTTP over TFTP proxy
 - SChannel rewrite with full server-side support

-### Changed
+- DuckDB support (`mormot.db.sql.duckdb.pas`), including ORM integration and a native client of the DuckDB Quack protocol
+### Breaking Changes
 - refactored main units to reduce their size: you may need to explicitly add `mormot.core.fmt`, `mormot.core.datetime` or `mormot.core.search` to your uses clause now
-- refactored cross-platform and cross-cpu conditionals (e.g. new internal `ASM*` definitions)
-- breaking change: deprecated GetExecutableVersion and TSynLog format as RawUtf8
-- Lots of bug fixes, optimisations and enhancements.
+- extracted the `ICrypt*` / `TCrypt*` high-level factories from `mormot.crypt.secure.pas` into the new `mormot.crypt.factory.pas` unit: add it to your `uses` clause if you call `Rnd()` `Hash()` `Sign()` `Cipher()` `Asym()` `Cert()` `Store()` or use `ICryptCert` / `ICryptStore`
+- extracted `THttpPeerCache` from `mormot.net.server.pas` into the new `mormot.net.peercache.pas` unit: add it to your `uses` clause if you use the peer-to-peer cache
+- extracted `THttpApiServer` and `THttpApiWebSocketServer` from `mormot.net.server.pas` into the new `mormot.net.server.win.pas` unit: add it to your `uses` clause if you use the Windows http.sys servers
+- extracted `THttpProxyServer` from `mormot.net.async.pas` into the new `mormot.net.proxy.pas` unit: add it to your `uses` clause if you use the HTTP proxy cache
+- deprecated GetExecutableVersion and TSynLog format as RawUtf8
+- refined cross-platform and cross-cpu conditionals (e.g. new internal `ASM*` definitions)
+### Changed
+- Numerous bug fixes, optimisations and enhancements

  name: new NotifyThreadEnded hook in mormot.core.os, redirected by

  an exception could not let Destroy wait for ever

commits.subject: mormot.core.zip: add ZipCrypto and WinZip AES-256 password support
commits.body:
- TZipWrite/TZipRead Password property, with TZipWrite.Encryption selecting
  the algorithm: zeAes256 (WinZip AE-2, default) or zeZipCrypto (traditional
  PKWARE, the only one supported by the Windows Explorer)
- mormot.core.zip only defines the abstract TZipCrypt class and the
  ZipCryptClass[] registration: no dependency on the crypt units
- new mormot.crypt.zip unit implementing both algorithms - just include it
  in the project to enable them:
  - TZipCryptAes: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 key derivation, AES-CTR with a
    little-endian counter, 80-bit HMAC-SHA1 authentication (AE-1/AE-2)
  - TZipCryptPkware: ZipCrypto with the keys held in local variables
- encrypted entries are supported by UnZip, UnZipStream and TestAll, from
  memory or from a file
- AddDeflatedStream works with AES; ZipCrypto raises an ESynZip since its
  header needs the crc32 before any data is written
- tests: Info-ZIP (ZipCrypto) and 7-Zip (AES-256) interoperability vectors,
  round trips for both algorithms, wrong/missing password, tampered content
